newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Profiles of Hong Kong's new elite.
newsitem.headline: Profiles of Hong Kong's new elite.

text.p: Future Hong Kong leader and shipping billionaire Tung Chee-hwa has studded his new Executive Council in Hong Kong with prominent, 40-something entrepreneurs intent on shaping Hong Kong in their own image -- efficient, well-educated and, above all, profitable.
While nobody doubts the new elite's commitment to a prosperous future, some question its understanding of the importance of a proper divide between commercial and political interests.
Few members of the Tung's incoming Executive Council have followed their new leader's example and placed their often extensive business holdings in trust.
Following is a brief profile of Tung and his executive advisers:
TUNG Chee-Hwa, 59

Vice-chairman of Preparatory Committee and the former chief executive of Orient Overseas (International) Ltd. Formerly Monaco's honorary consul in Hong Kong, Tung is a member of various international thinktanks.
Paul YIP Kwok-wah, 53 - Special Adviser
Chairman, Renful Group
Member Selection Committee, Preparatory Committee, Hong Kong Affairs Adviser. Chairman of Hong Kong Policy Research Institute. Director Hong Kong Institute for Promotion of Chinese Culture
Antony LEUNG Kam-chung, 45
Managing Director, Chase Manhattan Bank
Member Preparatory Committee, Selection Committee. Exchange Fund Advisory Committee. Airport Authority. Education Commission
Henry TANG Ying-yen, 44
Managing Director, Peninsula Knitters Ltd
Member Provisional Legislature, Selection Committee, chairman of Federation of Hong Kong Industries, Hong Kong General Chamber of Commerce, Council member Hong Kong Trade Development Council
LEUNG Chun-ying, 42
Managing director, C.Y. Leung & Co Ltd

Founding member One Country Two Systems Economic Research Institute. Member of New Hong Kong Alliance, Land Development Corporation, Hong Kong Housing Authority, New Airport Consultative Committee, Provisional Legislative Council, vice-chairman of the Preparatory Committee, former secretary general of the Basic Law Consultative Committee
Nellie FONG Wong Kut-man, 48
Deputy managing partner, Arthur Andersen & Co.
Member Selection Committee, Preparatory Committee. Chairperson of the Better Hong Kong Foundation. Member of Legco, Urban Council.
Charles LEE Yeh-kwong, 60
Partner, Woo Kwan Lee & Lo
Member Selection Committee, Governor's Business Council. Former chairman of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
CHUNG Sze-yuen, 79
Chairman of board, Honfam Co Ltd. Director, China Light & Power.

Member of Preparatory Committee, Selection Committee for the First Government of Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR). Life president of Hong Kong Federation of Industries. Member of Exco since 1972, member of Legco since 1965
YANG Ti-liang, 67
Former chief justice, popular candidate for chief executive.
TAM Yiu-chung, 47

Vice-chairman, Hong Kong Federation of Trade Unions. Former member of Legco. Former member Basic Law Drafting Committee, member of Selection Committee for First Government of the HKSAR, Provisional Legislative Council. Resigned post of vice-chairman of pro-Beijing Democratic Alliance for Betterment of Hong Kong after appointment to Exco.
Tim CHUNG Shui-ming, 45
Chief executive, Special Administrative Region Land Fund. Former Chinese representative, Sino-British Land Commission. Member Land Fund Investment Committee, Hong Kong Affairs Adviser
Rosanna WONG Yick-ming, 44
Executive director, The Hong Kong Federation of Youth Camps
Member Hong Kong Exco, Chairman of Housing Authority, Independent Commission Against Corruption complaints committee, Fight Crime Committee, former member of Legco
Raymond CH'IEN Kuo-fung, 45
Group managing director, Lam Soon Hong Kong Group
(resigned effective in July, 1997)

Member Exco, Selection Committee, Economic Advisory Committee, Chairman of Hong Kong Industrial Technology Centre Corporation, Industry & Technology Development Council, former chairman of the Federation of Hong Kong Industries.
